scenes.title: Plan the date. Then poke it.
scenes.say: Projections is where fire turns your net worth into a retirement date, and then lets you argue with it.

scenes.title: One click, four strategies.
scenes.say: Pick a growth preset: conservative, standard, aggressive, or early retiree. One click sets your return, inflation and withdrawal rate, and the whole projection redraws.

scenes.title: Every flavor of FIRE.
scenes.say: Lean, regular and fat FIRE targets, a Coast FIRE line, and the U.S. median for context. Toggle any of them right on the chart.

scenes.title: Milestones, with dates.
scenes.say: Milestone predictions put an age on every step, from your emergency fund to Coast FIRE to the full number. If the money would ever run out, they tell you when.

scenes.title: Bear. Base. Bull.
scenes.say: Shift returns two points either way to see your worst and best case, and watch how far your retire age moves.

scenes.title: What if?
scenes.say: Scenario comparison lines up a raise, a crash and an inflation spike side by side, each with its own FIRE age.

scenes.title: Every CD, on the timeline.
scenes.say: CDs get their own ladder, and every maturity is marked on the growth chart, so you know exactly when cash frees up.

scenes.title: Know your date. And how sturdy it is.
scenes.say: fire. Try it live at lifefire dot netlify dot app.
